title: Glossary
text:
Terms used across the site.







Term
Definition




Two-mode (bipartite) network
A network with two kinds of node, where edges join only nodes of different kinds. Here the kinds are codes, sub-elements, headings and works.


Network
A two-mode network stored as an .rds file. There are four: definitions × sub-elements, definitions × headings, works × sub-elements, works × headings.


Graph
The igraph object holding a network’s vertices, edges and attributes.


Biadjacency matrix
The 0/1 matrix with one row per node of one kind and one column per node of the other. It is stored alongside the graph in the definitions files.


Code (K&K code)
One numbered culture definition in Kroeber & Kluckhohn’s classification, such as A-14. The “definitions” in network names are these codes.


Sub-element
A specific element listed under a heading in K&K’s Index B, such as “systems”.


Heading
A grouping in Index B that holds sub-elements.


Work
A publication behind one or more codes, keyed by its author set and year (for example, Kelly & Kluckhohn 1945a).


Index A / Index B
K&K’s two indexes: Index A lists the authors and years behind each code, and Index B lists the codes under each sub-element and heading.


Boroch code
The code label from Boroch’s (2016) reanalysis of the same classification, attached where it matches a K&K code.


Vertex / edge
A node / a link between two nodes. Attributes are properties of either.


Parse flag
A marker on an edge saying how its source row was read: ok, ocr_corrected, code_not_in_index_a, junk_name or manual_fix.


Work table
The per-work table (one row per work, with its codes and counts). The release includes it; the site’s works files do not.


Split file
A works network published on the site as a graph only, without the work table.


Publication type (pub_type)
The kind of publication a work is: article, book, chapter or other.


Release / version
The data bundle, which includes a changelog and a manifest. The version follows MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH; a minor bump adds data or changes network contents.

title: Download
text: Each file is an R object (.rds), so read it with readRDS().

title: Download
text:
Reading the files in R
library(igraph)

base <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/olizardo/definitions-of-culture-two-mode/gh-pages/data/"
defs <- readRDS(gzcon(url(paste0(base, "kk-index-b-verified-network.rds"))))
g_defs <- defs$graph
m_defs <- defs$biadjacency

g_works <- readRDS(gzcon(url(paste0(base, "kk-index-b-works-sub-element-network.rds"))))
The definitions files are lists. Take $graph for the igraph object and $biadjacency for the 0/1 matrix. The works files are igraph objects directly. The work table is not included, but each work vertex carries its codes, n_codes, n_concepts, year, decade, label, and pub_type attributes.

title: Kroeber & Kluckhohn Two-Mode Network Data
text: Preliminary release, version 0.3.0. The data are subject to further verification and cleaning. Later versions may change the networks. See the changelog for the version history.

title: Kroeber & Kluckhohn Two-Mode Network Data
text:
Overview
These are two-mode (bipartite) networks built from the index of Kroeber and Kluckhohn’s Culture: A Critical Review of Concepts and Definitions (1952). Index B assigns each of the 170 culture definitions (K&K codes) to the headings and sub-elements under which the monograph indexes it. Index A gives the author and year behind each code. The works network links each of the 133 works to the same sub-elements and headings.
Boroch’s (2016) reanalysis of the same classification supplies the Boroch code labels, which are attached as vertex attributes where his Table 2 or appendix covers the same definition.

title: Kroeber & Kluckhohn Two-Mode Network Data
text:
How the data were built
Index A and Index B were parsed from the OCR text layer of the 1952 monograph. Parsing errors were corrected where the printed page image settled the reading, and each correction records its basis. Codes that Index A does not list are kept in the networks only when they are linked to an Index B element through the verified-code rules.

title: Kroeber & Kluckhohn Two-Mode Network Data
text:
Known limitations

Most corrections have one reader. A second reader has not yet checked all of them.
Some OCR tokens were resolved from the printed sequence rather than the page image, and are flagged as such in the build records.
Sub-element and heading labels other than the corrected ones have not all been checked against the page image.
Some sub-elements sit under more than one heading. The sub-element network merges same-name elements; use the heading network when the heading matters.
A work is keyed by its author set and year. Entries without a year are dropped.

title: Kroeber & Kluckhohn Two-Mode Network Data
text:
Rights
The data are derived coded structure: codes, authors, years, sub-element and heading labels and incidence. They contain no definition text or verbatim quotations. The 1952 monograph is publicly available online, and its element labels are included on that basis. Boroch’s article is not included.

title: Kroeber & Kluckhohn Two-Mode Network Data
text:
Citation
Please cite the data set, and the sources it is derived from:

Lizardo, Omar. 2026. Kroeber & Kluckhohn Culture Definitions: Two-Mode Network Data (version 0.3.0, preliminary release). Data set. https://olizardo.github.io/definitions-of-culture-two-mode/
Kroeber, A. L., and Clyde Kluckhohn. 1952. Culture: A Critical Review of Concepts and Definitions. Papers of the Peabody Museum of American Archaeology and Ethnology 47(1). Cambridge, MA: Harvard University.
Boroch, Robert. 2016. “A Formal Concept of Culture in the Classification of Alfred L. Kroeber and Clyde Kluckhohn.” Analecta XXV(2).

title: Codebook
text: The networks are bipartite igraph graphs. The definitions files are lists that hold the igraph graph (graph) and a 0/1 biadjacency matrix (biadjacency); the works files are igraph graphs alone. Vertex type is FALSE for sub-element, heading and work vertices and TRUE for codes or works, depending on the network. Codes are the K&K codes (the definitions). Read the files with readRDS(). The library is igraph.

title: Codebook
text:
Graph and edge attributes








Attribute
Level
Meaning




name
all vertices
sub-element label, heading label, K&K code, or work label


built, igraph_version, source_files, caveat
graph (definitions networks only)
build date, versions, source files, and a caveat that the Index B data are not fully verified


n_source_rows
edge (definitions networks only)
number of Index B rows behind the tie


parse_flags
edge (definitions networks only)
parse flags of those rows (ok, ocr_corrected, code_not_in_index_a, junk_name, manual_fix), separated by ;

title: Codebook
text:
Sub-element and heading vertices







Attribute
Meaning




node_type
sub_element or heading


headings
headings the sub-element appears under, separated by ; (sub-element network only)


n_headings
number of headings the sub-element appears under (sub-element network only)


n_subelements
sub-elements under the heading (heading network only)


n_codes
codes linked to the sub-element or heading


has_junk_name, has_manual_fix, has_ocr_correction
the sub-element or heading has an edge with that parse flag (sub-element network only)

title: Codebook
text:
Code vertices (definitions networks)







Attribute
Meaning




kk_group, kk_subgroup
K&K group letter and subgroup (for example A, I)


in_index_a, in_index_b
the code appears in Index A or Index B


n_index_b_elements
Index B sub-elements under the code


index_a_authors
Index A authors listed under the code, with qualifiers


boroch_code, boroch_source
Boroch’s code for the same definition (NA if none), and whether it comes from table2 or appendix-only

title: Codebook
text:
Work vertices (works networks)



Attribute
Meaning




node_type
work


codes
K&K codes the work sits under, separated by ;


n_codes, n_concepts
number of codes and of Index B concepts for the work


year
year as printed, with any letter suffix


decade
decade of the year (integer)


label
short author-year label


pub_type
publication type from the K&K bibliography entry: article (journal article), book (monograph, including numbered series), chapter (entry in an edited volume or reference work), or other (mimeographed, unpublished, or pamphlet or bulletin; some assignments are uncertain, see the changelog)



The works files store the bipartite graph only; the work table is not included. A work is keyed by its author set and year. A work can sit under several codes, and a code can hold several works.

title: Changelog
text: Versions follow MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. A minor bump adds data or changes network contents; a patch fixes an error in existing data without changing its structure.

title: Changelog
text:
0.3.0 (2026-10-25)

Added pub_type to the work vertices of both works networks. Values: article, book, chapter, other. Of the 133 works, 27 are articles, 91 books, 8 chapters and 7 other. A chapter is an entry in an edited volume or a reference work; numbered monograph series count as books. Blumenthal 1937 and Steward 1950 are uncertain and coded other.
The network structure is unchanged: vertices, edges and edge weights are the same as in 0.2.0.
Refreshed the network files from the current build. The works networks keep the same 133 works.

title: Changelog
text:
0.2.0 (2026-10-26)

Added kk-index-b-work-citations.csv: 133 works with their codes, surnames, year, K&K and Boroch match status, and the Boroch reference.
Refreshed the three network files from the current build. The works networks now have 133 works (v0.1.0 had 136). The works-level outputs were compared with the previous build: centrality is stable, CA positions are moderately stable, and MST community assignments changed for about a third of the works. Edge-level changes were not compared one by one.
Changed MANIFEST.md to list each object’s dimensions as rows × columns.

Known open items in the citation table:

Some rows have a K&K line from another author (year_only_no_author), or no K&K match.
Five works are in K&K only (kk_only). Roberts 1951 and Young 1944 have year conflicts.
The Committee mimeograph (Bernard, Blumenthal, Dodd, Hart 1941) is one work with five codes.
